senses.gloss: (v. מוּשׁ, מָשַׁשׁ) to touch, feel; to handle, manipulate; to examine, search.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 21b:10">B. Mets. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>אדם עשוי למַשְׁמֵשׁ בכיסו וכ׳</he> a person (carrying money with him on the road) usually feels for his bag at short intervals.
<cite ref="Menachot 36a:7">Men. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>מְמַשְׁמֵשׁ בהן</he> he puts his hand on them.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54b:1">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> top <he>כל זמן שאדם ממשמש בה</he> as often as one searches it (the figtree); <he>כ״ז שהתינוק ממשמש בו</he> as often as the suckling touches the breasts.
<cite ref="Shabbat 82a:6">Sabb. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>יְמַשְׁמֵשׁ בצרור וכ׳</he> let him manipulate (stimulate the rectum) with pebbles.
<cite ref="Eruvin 13b:14">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>ימשמש במעשיו</he> let him examine what he is doing, contrad. to <he>יפשפש</he> search (investigate) his past doings.
<cite ref="Ketubot 12a:9">Keth. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>למַשְׁמֵשׁ את וכ׳</he> to be around (watch) the bridegroom and bride (in order to prevent deception).
Snh. 63ᵇ מְמַשְׁמְשִׁין בהן they (the famished animals) licked them (begging for food); a. fr.—מ׳ ובא to come gropingly, slowly.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:1:2">Y. Peah VIII, beg. 20ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00678"><he>מוּשׁ</he></cite> h.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:5:2">Y. Ned. III, 38ᵃ</cite> <he>ראה … ממשמשין ובאין</he> if he saw the king’s cutters come near and nearer, v. <cite ref="S01793"><he>קָצוֹעַ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:5:2">ib.</cite> <he>ראה דליקה מְמַשְׁמֶשֶׁת ובאה</he> if he saw the fire coming near and nearer.

senses.gloss: to be attended to, watched. Keth. l. c. כל שלא מ׳ when he was not watched.
